title: Legacy console page routes
responsibility: Parses and formats the earlier commit-based console paths, preserving branch names and view-specific selections.

inputs.name: consoleRoutePath.route
inputs.description: The route to encode: the branch (null for a commit that no branch reaches), the commit, the view, and the optional base, record and unit. Each branch segment, the record and the unit are URI-encoded, the commit, view and base are written as given without validation, base is written only for the compare view and record only for the history view, and an empty-string branch yields a path that consoleRoute cannot read back.

inputs.name: consoleRoute.path
inputs.description: The console-relative path of a console page, /branch/<name>/commit/<sha>/<view> or /commit/<sha>/<view> for a commit on no branch, optionally followed by selections. The <sha> must be 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters, the view must be one of the consoleViews names, trailing slashes are removed first, and a branch name keeps any slashes it contains.

outputs.name: consoleViews
outputs.description: The five console view names, in the order map, compare, history, growth and activity, declared with as const so that ConsoleView is their union. The array is typed readonly but is not frozen at runtime, and consoleRoute accepts only these names as the view segment.

outputs.name: consoleRoute
outputs.description: The parsed route, with the branch decoded (null when the path has no branch part), base kept only for the compare view when the first part after the view is a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit, record kept only for the history view, and unit kept for any view. Trailing slashes are ignored, the result is undefined when the path does not match that shape, when a branch fails URI decoding, or when the view is missing or unknown, and a malformed record or unit encoding is left out instead of failing.

outputs.name: consoleRoutePath
outputs.description: The canonical path, with each branch segment, the record and the unit URI-encoded, the branch part left out for a null branch, and the commit, view and base written as given. The base appears only for the compare view, the record only for the history view, and the unit for any view, each only when it is non-empty.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Thrown by encodeURIComponent in consoleRoutePath when the branch, the unit, or the record of a history route contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate. The commit, view and base are written without encoding, so they cannot cause this error.
